data.description: When wielding his deity's favored weapon, the sentinel gains a +1 sacred or profane bonus on attack and damage rolls. These bonuses increase by 1 for every 3 levels he has in the sentinel prestige class (maximum +4) * His deity's favored weapon also functions as a holy (or unholy) symbol when wielded by a sentinel.
data.name: Symbolic Weapon
